title: Social Comparison Bias
coreMove: Detect when the social comparison pattern is tilting the evidence, then force the missing comparison before deciding.
sourcePressure: The frozen TOC and official source notes frame Social Comparison Bias as a specific decision error around social comparison, status threat, collaborator. Traceable support includes Tainted recommenda- tions: The social comparison bias.
